EC1: Richter's syndrome [OR], Burkitt's lymphoma [OR], or Burkitt-like Lymphoma [OR] (transformed DLBCL from Follicular NHL are eligible).
EC2: Prior transplant  with stem cell infusion 90 days [OR] or active graft-versus-host treatment within 8 weeks of Day 1.
EC4: Chronic treatment with strong CYP3A4  inhibitor [OR]/ inducer [OR], acid reducing agent [OR], Proton pump inhibitors
EC5: Known lymphomatous involvement of the CNS.
EC6: Persistent, unresolved NCI CTCAE v4.0 ≥ Grade 2 [OR], previous drug-related toxicity ([NOT] except alopecia [OR], erectile impotence [OR], hot flashes [OR], libido [OR], neuropathy).
EC7: Prior monoclonal antibody, radioimmunoconjugate, antibody drug conjugate, phototherapy, radiotherapy, chemotherapy, immunotherapy, immunosuppressive therapy, or any test agent within 3 weeks [OR] or for alemtuzumab 8 weeks of Day 1.
EC8: For CTCL: (TSEBT) within 12 weeks, or initiation of topical steroid [OR], nitrogen mustard [OR], or topical retinoid within 2 weeks. (Stable topical ≥ 4 weeks prior to Day 1 allowed).
EC9: Known carrier or infection for HIV [OR]/Hep [OR] B [OR] or C . HCV ab+  must be PCR-. HBV ab+ must be HBsAg- [OR] or undetectable DNA
EC11: Significant GI disease, previous major gastric [OR]/bowel surgery, [AND] difficulty swallowing [OR] or malabsorption syndrome.
EC13: Previous malignancies within 2 yrs. unless relapse risk is small (< 5%).
EC14: Current use of systemic steroids >20 mg QD prednisone (or equivalent)
EC15: Breastfeeding [OR] or pregnant (intention to become) females or participation in other clinical trials
